From plump burgers to loaded ‘Schnittys’, perfectly crispy fried chicken to anytime ‘brekkie’ meals, ‘Sub’ rolls to saucy and loaded fries, the Good to Go Takeaway promises a lip-smacking treat.

Lee, who is also a certified chef, prides over an immaculately hygienic kitchen. “We cook as though we are cooking for our own family,” says Lee who shares the ingredients to her secret sauce – “lots of passion, love and care”.
